id.description:
An id that can optionally be associated with this step.
Not used by the progress indicator, but can be useful for custom transforms/epics.

title.description: The main text describing what this step is about

subtitle.description: The smaller text below the main title for any additional information about the step

bannerTitle.description:
Title to show in banner above children. Only displayed if
{@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorChildrenContainerSettings} sets `showBanner` to true

bannerSubtitle.description:
Subtitle to show in banner above children. Only displayed if
{@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorChildrenContainerSettings} sets `showBanner` to true

isDisabled.description: Whether the step is disabled or not. If disabled it will appear at a dimmer opacity and have no pointer events.

status.description:
The status of a step that will reflect in the step's left border color and icon. Will also show in the
banner if present.

substeps.description: Array of {@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep} substeps that are nested underneath a given step

children.description: A array of objects containing component Id strings used to render a NestedComponent for this step

title:
A UI component type that displays a step
as part of a larger sequence of steps in a parent {@link UiSdlProgressIndicator} component
name: UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep
